<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Public onboarding for the landed Rust SDK/CLI, a safely quoted checkout-based just install recipe, and conditional missing-harness setup guidance.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Readers understand standard native telemetry projection and caller-owned integration/reporting.
- Users install/reinstall from the checkout and execute real CLI/SDK examples.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- No new telemetry/discovery/resume/retention semantics.
- No operator binary overwrite during validation, global setup change or workspace retirement.
